unitTitle: The Loch Ness Monster — Episode 2: The Wrong Photograph
scanNote:
46-BET. 'The Loch Ness Monster' hikoyasining 2-epizodi — 'The Wrong Photograph' (komiks).

Skaner bilan tekshirildi. Voqealar tartibi:
  1) Sandra suvda, Devid qayiqda fotoapparat bilan
  2) Devid qo'l cho'zadi, Sandrani tortib oladi
  3) Sandra qayiqda, Devid unga kiyim beradi ('Brrr! I'm cold')
  4) 'Where's the monster?' — 'It's gone. We're safe now'
  5) 'AT THE TRAIN STATION...' — Devid Maykka qo'ng'iroq qiladi
  6) 'BACK IN LONDON...' — Mayk konvertni ochadi
  7) Suratlarda Nessi emas, SANDRAning yuzi chiqadi

⚠ HIKOYANING KALITI: Mayk 'the monster has got BLONDE HAIR and BIG BLUE EYES! It's scared too!' deydi — ya'ni Devid suv ostidagi Sandrani suratga olgan. Sarlavha 'The Wrong Photograph' shuni bildiradi.

⚠ MUHIM TAFSILOTLAR (47-betdagi 7-mashq uchun kerak):
  • Poyezd bekati — 'AT THE TRAIN STATION' (avtobus EMAS)
  • Devid telefonda: 'It's HUGE! It's got a LONG neck and a SMALL head' (kichkina EMAS)
  • Devid Maykka HODISA haqida emas, MAXLUQ va SURATLAR haqida aytadi
  • Suratlarda DEVIDning emas, SANDRAning yuzi

7 ta buyruq gap: Help me! / Don't be afraid Sandra. / Swim fast! / Help! / Just take my hand! / Here, put this on. / Don't worry.
6 ta savol: David! Where are you? / Are you okay? / Where's the monster? / Well, David, are these the photographs of Nessie? / What?! / Where are the photographs of Nessie?

exercises.instructionEn: Read and listen to Episode 2 of the story: The Wrong Photograph.
exercises.instructionUz: Hikoyaning 2-epizodini o'qing va tinglang: Noto'g'ri surat.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLDINGI EPIZOD (24–25-bet, 1-epizod: The Accident):
  Devid — 'Morning Star' gazetasining fotografi.
  Sandra — jurnalist. Ular Shotlandiyaga, Loch Ness ko'liga
  mashhur maxluq 'Nessie' ni suratga olish uchun borishgan.
  Ular qayiqda ko'lga chiqishgan va HALOKATGA uchrashgan.

BU EPIZOD (2-epizod: The Wrong Photograph):
  Sandra suvga tushib qolgan. Devid uni qutqaradi.
  Ular Nessi suratlarini olganiga ishonishadi.
  Londonda muharrir Mayk konvertdagi suratlarni ochadi —
  va u yerda Nessi emas, SANDRAning surati chiqadi!

SARLAVHA MA'NOSI:
  'The Wrong Photograph' = Noto'g'ri surat
  Devid maxluq o'rniga Sandrani suratga olib qo'ygan.

QAHRAMONLAR:
  David  — fotograf (sariq kurtkada)
  Sandra — jurnalist (sariq sochli, qizil kurtkada)
  Mike   — muharrir (Londonda, keksa, ko'zoynakli)

sentences.en: Sandra: David! Where are you? Help me!
sentences.noteUz:
1-rasm: Sandra suvda, Devid qayiqda fotoapparat bilan.
'Help me!' = Menga yordam ber!

sentences.en: David: Don't be afraid Sandra. Swim fast!
sentences.noteUz:
'Don't be afraid' = qo'rqma (buyruq gapning inkori: DON'T + BE).
'afraid' = qo'rqqan. 'fast' — ravish, '-ly' QO'SHILMAYDI.

sentences.en: Sandra: David! Help! I can't swim very well. The water's cold and I'm scared!
sentences.uz: Sandra: Devid! Yordam! Men yaxshi suza olmayman. Suv sovuq va men qo'rqyapman!
sentences.noteUz:
'I can't swim very well' — 'can' ning inkori.
'The water's' = The water IS (qisqartma).
'scared' = qo'rqqan ('afraid' bilan bir xil).

sentences.en: David: It's all right Sandra. Just take my hand!
sentences.uz: Devid: Hammasi joyida, Sandra. Faqat qo'limdan ushla!
sentences.noteUz:
'It's all right' = hammasi joyida, xavotir olma.
'take my hand' = qo'limdan ushla (buyruq gap).
'okay' (OK) = yaxshi, joyida. Kundalik nutqda juda ko'p ishlatiladi.

sentences.en: Sandra: Yes, David. Thank you. Brrr! I'm cold.
sentences.uz: Sandra: Ha, Devid. Rahmat. Brrr! Sovqotdim.
sentences.noteUz:
'I'm cold' = men sovqotdim. DIQQAT: 'I have cold' XATO.
'Brrr!' — sovuqdan qaltirash tovushi.

sentences.en: David: Don't worry. It's gone. We're safe now, and we've got photos of Nessie.
sentences.uz: Devid: Xavotir olma. U ketdi. Endi biz xavfsizmiz va bizda Nessining suratlari bor.
sentences.noteUz:
'Don't worry' = xavotir olma.
'It's gone' = u ketdi, yo'qoldi.
'safe' = xavfsiz. 'Nessie' — Loch Ness maxlug'ining erkalab aytilishi.

sentences.en: David (on the phone): Hello Mike, David here. Bingo!
sentences.uz: Devid (telefonda): Salom Mayk, bu Devid. Zo'r!
sentences.noteUz:
'David here' — telefonda o'zini tanishtirish shakli.
'Bingo!' — 'topdim!', 'ana xolos!' degan quvonch nidosi.

sentences.en: David: I've got photos of the Loch Ness monster. It's amazing — it's huge!
sentences.uz: Devid: Menda Loch Ness maxlug'ining suratlari bor. Bu ajoyib — u juda katta!
sentences.noteUz:
'amazing' = hayratlanarli, ajoyib.
'huge' = juda katta, ulkan ('very big' dan kuchliroq).

sentences.en: David: It's got a long neck and a small head. We've got a really great story.
sentences.uz: Devid: Uning uzun bo'yni va kichik boshi bor. Bizda haqiqatan ajoyib maqola bor.
sentences.noteUz:
'a neck' = bo'yin. 'a head' = bosh.
'a story' bu yerda = gazeta maqolasi, xabar.

sentences.en: Sign at the station: Well done, David!
Mike: Well, David, are these the photographs of Nessie?
sentences.uz: Mayk: Xo'sh, Devid, bular Nessining suratlarimi?
sentences.noteUz:
'Well, ...' gap boshida = xo'sh, mayli.
'these' = bular (yaqindagi ko'plik narsa).

sentences.en: David: Yes, Mike. They're right here in this envelope!
sentences.uz: Devid: Ha, Mayk. Ular mana shu konvertda!
sentences.noteUz:
'right here' = aynan mana shu yerda ('right' kuchaytiruvchi).
'an envelope' = konvert.

sentences.en: Mike: Hmmm! That's interesting ... So the monster has got blonde hair and big blue eyes! It's scared too!
sentences.uz: Mayk: Hmmm! Qiziq ekan... Demak, maxluqning sariq sochi va katta ko'k ko'zlari bor ekan! U ham qo'rqib turibdi!
sentences.noteUz:
Mayk KINOYA qilyapti — u suratda Sandrani ko'ryapti.
'blonde hair' = sariq (oqish) soch.
'So ...' = demak, shunday ekan.

sentences.en: David: Oh no! Where are the photographs of Nessie?
sentences.noteUz:
'Oh no!' = voy! attang!
Demak, Devid noto'g'ri plyonkani bergan — bu epizod sarlavhasi.

exercises.explanationUz:
Bu savollar hikoyani tushunganingizni tekshiradi.
Javoblarni komiksdagi gaplardan toping.

items.answer: Because she is in the water and she can't swim very well.
items.whyUz: Sandra suvga tushib qolgan: 'I can't swim very well. The water's cold and I'm scared!'

items.answer: He gives her his hand and pulls her into the boat.
items.whyUz: Devid: 'Just take my hand!' — so'ng uni qayiqqa tortib oladi.

items.answer: Because the water is cold and she is wet.
items.whyUz:
Sandra suvda bo'lgani uchun sovqotgan. Devid unga kiyim beradi:
'Here, put this on.'

items.textEn: What does David say about the monster on the phone?
items.answer: He says it is amazing and huge, and it has got a long neck and a small head.
items.whyUz: Devid: 'It's amazing — it's huge! It's got a long neck and a small head.'
Devid: 'They're right here in this envelope!'

items.answer: There is a photograph of Sandra, not the monster.
items.whyUz:
Mayk: 'the monster has got blonde hair and big blue eyes' — bu Sandraning tavsifi.
Oxirgi rasmda Sandraning qo'rqqan surati ko'rinadi.

items.textEn: Why is the episode called 'The Wrong Photograph'?
items.answer: Because David has got a photograph of Sandra instead of the monster.
items.whyUz:
Devid maxluq o'rniga Sandrani suratga olgan — noto'g'ri surat.
'instead of' = ...ning o'rniga.

groups.explanationUz: Bir xil ma'noli, lekin turlicha ishlatiladigan so'zlar.
Fe'lga yuklama qo'shilib yangi ma'no chiqadi.
Ega YOZILMAYDI, fe'l asos shaklida turadi.

patterns.explanationUz: Ega yozilmaydi. 'be' fe'li ham DON'T bilan inkor qilinadi.

O'zbekchada fe'l, inglizchada 'be' + SIFAT.
'I have cold' XATO.

patterns.exampleEn: It's got a long neck and a small head.
patterns.exampleUz: Uning uzun bo'yni va kichik boshi bor.
patterns.explanationUz: Birlik ega ('it') → HAS got, qisqartmasi 'It's got'.

patterns.exampleEn: They're right here in this envelope!
So the monster has got blonde hair and big blue eyes!
patterns.exampleUz: Demak, maxluqning sariq sochi va katta ko'k ko'zlari bor ekan!
patterns.explanationUz: 'So ...' gap boshida — xulosa chiqarish yoki kinoya qilish.
